blocks.title: Virtualization, Containers, and Specialized Systems comparison
Virtualization, Containers, and Specialized Systems exam shortcuts
items: Containers normally share the host OS kernel.
Example: Several Docker containers run on one Linux host.
Each VM has its own operating system.
Example: Windows and Linux VMs share one host.
Example: Smart cameras connect to the enterprise network.
Security must consider safety and availability.
Example: A controller must react within milliseconds.
blocks.example: Choose the architecture based on the security tradeoff emphasized in the scenario.

questions.q: Multiple application workloads run in isolated environments but share the same host OS kernel. Which model is this?
Windows and Linux workloads run as separate guest operating systems on one hypervisor. Which model is this?
questions.explanation: Virtual machines each use separate guest operating systems.

questions.q: A network-connected smart camera has limited compute power and inconsistent patch support. Which category best fits?
questions.explanation: IoT devices are specialized network-connected devices.

questions.q: A system directly controls industrial machinery and operational safety is the top concern. Which architecture is most relevant?
questions.explanation: ICS/SCADA systems monitor and control physical industrial processes.

questions.q: A controller must respond within a guaranteed number of milliseconds. Which model is most appropriate?
